sentences.text: No, a 2% pre-payment charge does not comply here because a Tier 4 UCB shall not levy prepayment charges on loans granted for business purpose to Micro and Small Enterprises.
The loan is a floating rate term loan sanctioned on 2026-03-15, and the applicable directions cover loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026.

The documents do not state that a Tier 4 UCB may levy any pre-payment charge for this MSE business loan, and the general policy-based rule applies only to cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2).

missing.slot: whether the 2% charge is allowed under any separate sanction-letter policy
